news.title: Stock Market Today: Sensex Gains Over 400 Points, Nifty 50 Opens Above 22,700; TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech Lead
news.summary: Among sectors, Nifty IT index was the only one to trade in the green. Losses were seen in Nifty Metals, Nifty Realty, Nifty Auto, Nifty Pharma and Nifty PSU Bank indices.

news.title: IT Stocks Rally: Nifty IT Jumps Over 1.3%; TCS, Infosys, Wipro Lead Gains
news.summary: TCS shares gain 3.05% to Rs 2,583.30, while Infosys advances 2.32% to Rs 1,180.10. Wipro rises 1.47% to Rs 193.21, and HCL Technologies climbs 1.56% to Rs 1,443.90.

news.title: IT Stocks In Red: Nifty IT Index Drops Nearly 2% As Infosys, TCS, Mphasis Shares Lead Losses
news.summary: All constituents of the Nifty IT index traded in the red, with Infosys, Mphasis, Wipro, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and HCL Technologies among the major laggards.

news.title: IT Stocks In Red: Infosys, Coforge, Mphasis Lead Losses; Nifty IT Tanks Over 3%
news.summary: The Nifty IT index slipped 3.38% as selling pressure hit large-cap and mid-cap IT stocks. Infosys, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra, and TCS were among the major losers

news.title: Jio Listing: Telco's Stellar Debut Knocks TCS Out Of India's Top Five, SBI Climbs
news.summary: Tata Consultancy Services slipped to seventh place by market value on Wednesday morning. Jio Platforms went straight to No. 2 on its first day of trading, and a sell-off in IT stocks let State Bank of India move past the software major as well.
